ex.zh: 我能做出好的食物选择，养成健康的饮食习惯。

ex.en: What's more, reading helps me develop a good habit of learning English.
ex.zh: 而且，阅读帮助我养成了学习英语的好习惯。

ex.en: For example, some people have fast food every week.
ex.zh: 例如，有些人每周都吃快餐。

ex.en: I made a new year's resolution to eat less fast food.
ex.zh: 我新年的决心是少吃快餐。

ex.en: But it often has lots of salt, fat, and sugar.
ex.zh: 但它常常含有很多盐、脂肪和糖。

ex.en: Beat the eggs with salt.
ex.zh: 把鸡蛋加盐打散。

ex.en: Some fat can even encourage our body to lose weight.
ex.zh: 有些脂肪甚至能促进我们的身体减肥。

ex.en: It's able to stay alive during this long sleep because of its fat.
ex.zh: 它能在长时间的睡眠中活下来，是因为它的脂肪。

ex.en: Not all fat makes us gain weight.
ex.zh: 并不是所有脂肪都会让我们长胖。

ex.en: Remember, less weight means more energy for walking and traveling around.
ex.zh: 记住，负重越少，走路和到处旅行的精力就越多。

ex.en: Eating fast food like pizza and hamburgers too often may cause heart problems later.
ex.zh: 太常吃比萨和汉堡这样的快餐，以后可能会导致心脏问题。

ex.en: He had a hamburger and a glass of milk for lunch.
ex.zh: 他午饭吃了一个汉堡、喝了一杯牛奶。

ex.en: This can cause tooth problems.
ex.zh: 这会导致牙齿问题。

ex.en: In ancient China, floods broke out year after year, causing great problems.
ex.zh: 在中国古代，洪水年年发生，造成了巨大的问题。

ex.en: During exercise, our heart beats faster and we breathe harder.
ex.zh: 运动时，我们的心跳加快，呼吸加重。

ex.en: He watched the world with a clear mind and a kind heart.
ex.zh: 他用清醒的头脑和善良的心看待世界。

ex.en: Eating balanced meals is very important when we are young.
ex.zh: 我们年轻时吃均衡的饭菜非常重要。

ex.en: First, keep a balanced diet and avoid junk food.
ex.zh: 首先，保持均衡饮食，避免吃垃圾食品。

ex.en: These things are usually too small to see.
ex.zh: 这些东西通常太小，看不见。

ex.en: You may be too busy to notice the wonderful world where you live.
ex.zh: 你可能太忙了，没有注意到你所生活的美好世界。
